metadata.description: Tonary of Saint-Bénigne, Dijon, 10th–11th century; neumes and letter notation. H 159 files this gradual under tetrardus, ff. 98r–98v (Paléographie musicale VIII, table). Images: the black-and-white facsimile in Paléographie musicale VIII (1901–05), plates 189–190; the library's own scans are at https://ged.scdi-montpellier.fr/florabium45/jsp/nodoc.jsp?NODOC=2020_DOC_MONT_MBUM_6
metadata.transcription: Corpus Monodicum (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz / Universität Würzburg), document Mon 159-0194-7GS, https://stagedata.corpus-monodicum.de/mei/f6a886a9-d0d9-46cd-ab9c-131be8cd6f29/Mon%20159-0194-7GS.xml, which transcribes the Graduale Synopticum (Universität Regensburg; database by Xaver Kainzbauer), no. 0194; © Corpus Monodicum. Pitches at the manuscript's level, a fifth above that file, and an octave lower.
